name: eyechart
title: Eyechart
description: An optician's theme set in a dimmed test room: charcoal walls and one back-lit white panel where the services read as a letter chart in black slab capitals, first letters shrinking line by line beside 6/60 to 6/6, ending on a red-and-green duochrome row with the phone and after-hours numbers.

tokens.--font-slab: slab caps: chart lines, headings, site name, duochrome numbers
tokens.--font-sans: reading text, menu, labels, summaries, fractions, footer
tokens.--text-s: small text: fractions, summaries, labels, eyebrows, footer, pagination
tokens.--text-m: body size; site name, footer numbers
tokens.--text-l: ledes, blog list titles, the Before-your-visit heading
tokens.--text-xl: section headings and the appointment heading
tokens.--chart-poster: the top chart line's first letter; lines two to four step down from it
tokens.--chart-rest: the caps of every chart line and the duochrome Book label
tokens.--leading-tight: heading, chart line and button line height
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: ledes, eyebrows, dates, footer
tokens.--color-accent: links, bold words, Book and page buttons, current menu marker, quote and Before-your-visit rules, focus rings
tokens.--color-rule: hairlines; the thin line round the panel
tokens.--color-panel: the lit chart panel and the small chart by the site name
tokens.--color-chart-ink: the chart's black letters, links and focus rings on the panel
tokens.--color-chart-muted: acuity fractions and summaries on the panel
tokens.--color-frame: the frame round the panel, the duochrome box, a cover and the small chart
tokens.--color-glow: the panel's light on the wall (a shadow with the lights on)
tokens.--color-green: duochrome green half: the phone or e-mail
tokens.--color-red: duochrome red half: the after-hours line or Book
tokens.--color-on-duo: black words, figures and focus rings on the duochrome
tokens.--chart-width: home chart width; the care index panel is 1.4 times it
tokens.--space-3: base spacing step; the panel's side padding
tokens.--radius: corners of the panel, duochrome box and buttons
tokens.--frame: frame thickness round the panel, duochrome box and cover
